nodes.name: Sklearn SVM Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level public sklearn.svm estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above libsvm/liblinear compiled solvers.

nodes.name: svm_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose the public sklearn.svm estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: svm_estimator_backend
nodes.description: Return whether a public sklearn.svm estimator delegates to libsvm or liblinear.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time membership lookup over a fixed estimator set.

nodes.name: svm_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return the high-level learning task for a public sklearn.svm estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time membership lookup over fixed task groups.

nodes.name: svm_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level SVM routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns one fixed method tuple selected by estimator name and probability flag.

nodes.name: svm_linear_fit_liblinear_payload
nodes.description: Expose the _fit_liblinear keyword and positional payload assembled by LinearSVC/LinearSVR.fit.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator_name: str, C: float, fit_intercept: bool, intercept_scaling: float, class_weight: object, penalty: str, dual: bool, verbose: int, max_iter: int, tol: float, random_state: object, multi_class: str, loss: str, epsilon: float = 0.0, sample_weight: object = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom packages scalar configuration and object references without iterating over training data.

nodes.name: svm_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public SVM prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object, check_probability: bool = True) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates method availability and packages references, leaving prediction execution to sklearn.

nodes.name: svm_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted SVM estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: svm_libsvm_fitted_support_state
nodes.description: Expose fitted support-vector state after the deferred libsvm solver.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes support-vector arrays whose size is bounded by samples times features, without running libsvm.

nodes.name: svm_liblinear_fitted_state
nodes.description: Expose fitted coefficient state after the deferred liblinear solver.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes linear coefficient and intercept arrays, proportional to feature count and class count.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 1 public SVM estimator shells over libsvm/liblinear compiled solver boundaries
